notes: Observed 2026-09-23 on keh.com official sell pages. Distinct mechanism from R7030 (buying events). Numeric keys are example-based estimates for a typical single item, labeled per lane rules; official terms give no payout floor and state value varies by condition and demand - actual offers are per-item and can be $0 if the item is not accepted.
payout_quote: Ship your gear free; after inspection and your acceptance, we pay digital cash (ACH, PayPal, Venmo, or debit-to-bank) or issue a trade voucher - shortly after acceptance.

repeatable.cadence: You can do this once per gear item you own - it is bounded by the camera gear you already have, not a daily income stream.

s4.note: Quote is free with no obligation.

s6.note: Condition mismatch and repair needs reduce value - disclosed.

steps: Get an online quote for your camera gear
Accept and ship free with the prepaid label
KEH inspects the gear and confirms the offer
Accept the confirmed offer; digital cash (ACH/PayPal/Venmo/debit-to-bank) or trade voucher follows shortly after
timing: Digital cash or trade voucher issued shortly after inspection and acceptance; free insured shipping.
who_pays: KEH Camera - the company pays you directly after inspection, as digital cash or as a trade voucher.
who_qualifies: You must be 18+, in the US, and own the gear. Working photo and video gear in acceptable condition only.
work_available: Yes - the mail-in program was live on keh.com as of 2026-09-23. It covers working photo/video gear; repair needs reduce value.
what_gets_accepted: KEH's inspectors have the final word - the quote is revised if the gear's condition does not match your description. Grade conservatively; overgrading just gets revised down. The headline number is often the trade voucher, not the cash - cash is the lower number.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Free insured shipping, no fees. Your unpaid time is getting the quote, packaging carefully, transit, and waiting for inspection plus your acceptance.
when_cash_arrives: Real money - digital cash (ACH, PayPal, Venmo, or debit-to-bank) issued shortly after inspection and your acceptance. Or a higher-value trade voucher if you would buy camera gear anyway.
